name: area-chart
title: Area chart
description: A smooth line over a soft tint for a value that moves day by day, with an optional dashed comparison line, a crosshair tooltip that reads the difference, and room under zero for a dip.

props.name: data
props.description: One object per point, oldest first: `{ label, title?, value, previous? }`.

props.name: label
props.description: The chart's accessible name, such as "Everyday account balance, last 30 days".

props.name: format
props.description: How values are written in the tooltip, the table and on the axis.

props.name: compare
props.description: Draw each point's `previous` value as a dashed comparison line. Default on when any point has one.

props.name: current
props.description: The index of the current point (today), marked with the signal dot. Default the last point; null for none.

props.name: height
props.description: The chart's height in px, axis labels included. Default 300, 200 when narrower than 560 px, less when compact.

props.name: tickEvery
props.description: Label every nth point, counted back from the last. Also the Page Up / Page Down step. Default as many as fit, about six.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a breathing skeleton instead of data.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown over the empty frame when there is no data, such as a message and a next step.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: The highlighted point (an index into `data`), or null.

props.name: defaultActiveIndex
props.description: The highlighted point to start with, when `activeIndex` is not controlled. Default null.

props.name: onActiveIndexChange
props.description: Called when hover, a finger or the keyboard picks another point, and with null when it lets go.

props.name: labels
props.description: Every visible and spoken string that is not data.

a11y.text: The plot is one Tab stop. ArrowLeft and ArrowRight, Home and End step through the points; Page Up and Page Down jump one label step (tickEvery); Escape lets go.

The plot is an image named by label and described by a hint ("Use the arrow keys to read each point. Page Up and Page Down jump further."). Each step is read once through a polite live region, and a hidden table holds the data.
Under reduced motion the whole chart stands at once and the crosshair jumps instead of gliding.
